Δ = variant − live 3.3.0 on identical matches, 95% intervals from 2000 event bootstraps. Rolling origins: monthly Oct 2024–Jul 2026, each month's ρ chosen by Brier on the 365 days before it. Gate: Δ Brier interval below zero and neither accuracy nor margin-MAE interval entirely worse, on 2024–25 and 2025–26.
